 The Senior SAP Functional analyst is responsible for translating the Business requirements of the Functional Area in two functional areas which is Billing \& Invoicing and FICA or DM performing the duties of systems analysis, design, and development the SAP system via the SAP Configuration IMG (SAP Implementation Guide). This includes all aspects of project work, on\-going functional enhancements, troubleshooting, and SAP provided system and/or legal changes. An SAP Senior Functional Analyst collaborates on all phases of the systems development life\-cycle (SDLC) with a focus on the analysis, design, and development of configuration\-based solutions. Must continuously maintain and develop the necessary skillsets, both technical and analytical to enhance value\-added business solutions and in keeping with the IT architecture.
 



 Under minimal supervision, is responsible for all aspects of the Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC) in relation to SAP Configuration activities.
 



  





**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




 Implements software solutions for which in\-depth configuration and integration is required; drives substantial interaction with vendor resources and integrates applications with complex interfaces based on specifications provided.
 



 Hands\-on experience in SAP IS\-U Billing \& Invoicing, with deep functional expertise across the meter\-to\-cash lifecycle in the utility industry (Electricity \& Gas).
 



 Expert in configuring and customizing billing master data i.e., billing schemas, rate modelling including complex billing, regulated and de\-regulated tariff models.
 



 Strong knowledge of the end\-to\-end billing and invoicing process including budget billing, RTP billing, TOU billing, mass batch jobs, exception management, bill simulation, unbilled revenue scenarios and collective billing.
 



 Working knowledge of SAP ISU Bill Print, including Print Workbench configuration and integration with Smart Forms and Adobe Forms.
 



 Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams including integration with Device Management and FICA.
 



 Extensive functional and solution experience with the ability to facilitate, design, and develop complex solutions aligned with digital transformation initiatives.
 



 Strong client\-facing skills – ability to serve as a functional liaison between business and IT. Guide stakeholders on best practices.
 



 Experience in SAP S/4 HANA utilities and Fiori; ability to analyze, debug and troubleshoot OData and web services used in integrations.
 



 Participates on an Application Development and Support team as well as project teams under the direction of their Lead SAP Configurator, Manager or Project Managers. Functions as Technical Lead on projects; may lead multiple concurrent projects.
 



 Subject matter expert in multiple business unit areas, including those relevant to projects and application support assignments.
 



 Considered a subject matter expert in their technical discipline; mentors and guides junior staff. Develops and drives standard practices within their team; collaborates with Business Systems Analysts and/or Business Partners to develop software specifications.
 



 Acquires and maintains appropriate technical skills and mentors junior staff. Participates in developing and driving standard practices within their team.
 



 Supports the request and analysis phases of SDLC by assisting with documentation and estimates. Executes the design, development, and implementation phases of SDLC by producing the prescribed deliverables; reviews deliverables produced by junior staff.
 



 Liaises with business partners and business unit leads to conduct analysis and design efforts for future enhancements and configuration to meet changing policy and legislative requirements.
 



 Maintains awareness of current trends in the business marketplace with a focus on product and service development, delivery and support, and applying key technologies. Examine trends in information systems training, materials and techniques. Coordinate system changes by identifying system requirements, definition, testing, training and implementation as well as provide specifications to work management systems, third party remittance, IT, and other areas of the organization.
 



 Participates in business process modeling sessions, while assisting in the collection and consolidation of required information and data in the development of analysis documentation in accordance with the SDLC methodology. Supports the creation of business process procedures for assigned business unit(s).
 



 Develops strong business and system knowledge relating to functional areas and assigned business unit(s). Supports the maintenance and evolution of the logical data model and business process model for assigned business unit(s). Provides input and direction on business unit technology strategies.
 



 Provide training and guidance and oversee work of staff/AMS contractors to ensure quality results.
 



 Development, growth, and mentoring of SAP Configurators.
 



 Should be able to perform budget, forecast, and calculate the actuals for project and maintain financials.

jobs.description:
**Experience:** 10 – 12 Years

**Key Responsibilities:**  
● Full ownership of projects and quality of changes, from planning, communication, coordination, compliance aspects, customization and go\-live hypercare;  
● Analytical thinking  
● Providing scalable and innovative solutions.  
● Ability to take fast decisions in a very dynamic environment, with some level of uncertainty  
● Contribute to the identification of opportunities (processes, people) to improve project delivery and/or development methodologies.  
● Training of key users and key user support. Analyzing issues and changes.  
● Day to day support and incident resolution

**Mandatory Experience \& Technical Skills**  
1\. SAP Finance Core \& Architectural Setup  
● Deep Structural Design: Proven hands\-on experience in the end\-to\-end setup of global templates, including Enterprise Structure and Global Organisation set up.  
● Detailed Configuration: Expert\-level mastery in configuring (not limited to):  
○ Organizational Units: Controlling Area, Operating Concern (CO\-PA), and Company Code. Chart of Accounts.  
○ Financial Framework: Ledgers, Currencies, Segments, and Fiscal Year/Posting Period variants.  
○ Master Data \& Hierarchies: Cost Center/Profit Center Hierarchies, Internal Order Types, and Account Groups.  
○ Fixed Assets: Chart of Depreciation, Depreciation Areas, and Asset Classes.  
● SAP RISE Experience: Direct Hands\-on experience in SAP RISE (Private Cloud Edition), including leading "Explore" phase workshops to define enterprise standards. Should have in\-depth knowledge and experience of RISE product offerings.

2\. Specialized Contract Accounting (FICA) / BRIM  
● Project Delivery: At least one full\-cycle implementation (Greenfield or Brownfield) of SAP FICA or BRIM / Convergent Invoicing.  
● Convergence: Strong understanding of how high\-volume billing data flows from digital interfaces into the General Ledger.  
3\. Advanced Financial Modules \& Controlling  
● Operational Excellence: Deep expertise in General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Asset Accounting.  
● Treasury \& Banking: Hands\-on configuration of Bank Communication Management (BCM) and specialized Intercompany Accounting processes.  
● Controlling (CO\-PA): Advanced knowledge of Controlling and Profitability Analysis to drive business insights and financial reporting.  
● Version Versatility: Proficiency in mapping business processes across both SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments.  
Integration \& Stakeholder Management  
● System Ecosystems: Excellent knowledge of integrating SAP FI with complex legacy systems and external digital interfaces.  
● Interface Logic: Solid understanding of data mapping across FI\-GL, Business Partners, and payment gateways.  
● Communication: Fluent English with a proven track record of managing high\-level stakeholders and delivering technical presentations to non\-technical audiences. Ability to derive decisions and conclude discussions amongst different stakeholders.  
Behavioral Competencies  
● Agility: Ability to grasp complex technical details quickly and manage multiple high\-priority deliverables in a fast\-paced, "quick turnaround" environment.  
● Strategic Thinking: Ability to see beyond the configuration and understand the business impact of architectural decisions.

**Key Metrics for Success**  
● Successful leadership of Explore Workshops for global rollouts, Hands on knowledge of SAP RISE product offerings.  
● Delivery of a stabilized FICA/BRIM environment.  
● Improvement of financial data quality and integration efficiency with legacy platforms.

Pay: ₹2,700,000\.00 \- ₹2,800,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Delhi
